rule: a B1 gate is resolved when every case it needs exists and carries a verdict; every verdict is formed with the unified comparison rule of the revision (resolved when |D + beta_D| > U95(D): D the difference at the production mesh, beta_D its signed discretization bias and U95(D) the uncertainty of the difference (about 95 %: GCI-type discretization bands (Roache; Fs = 1.25 asymptotic, 3 otherwise) and the other components as 95 % half-widths, in quadrature); the joint response must be resolved under every law of the solder-law band; a case without a ladder of its own carries no U (provisional only with a checked transfer)); PAPER_READY requires every B1 gate resolved

rule_change.note: unique (case, observable) robustness rows; legacy = gap > 2 x the r21 -> r31 step (old rows) or |D| > 2 U_D_paired (newer rows); unified = tcpmt_resolution.RULE; all variant verdicts are provisional (production pair's U transferred on the identical mesh, r11 check runs pending)
